title: Looking for Hotel Bartender
content: My mall world contains a very luxurious hotel. Pools in front and back, plus a beach in the back. Lobby has polished red wood accents and a lot of modern glass elements. I stay in the lobby because the rooms contain confusion and peril and go on forever. Been going to this place for years in my dreams. There is a Bartender there I speak to, I know he is a real person, though he could be living or perhaps already passed. Are you the Bartender? Tall and thin, approx late 50s, Caucasian, curly white hair, with a very calm demeanor even when chaos is all around? Do you remember when waves of people were washing in from the ocean and the hotel couldnt fit them all? Do you help people get out of the scary labyrinth of rooms when they get lost? If you're the Bartender, I'd love to meet you in real life. I never remember to ask your name.
